about: What a class's own code does to a placed moby when the level starts, which the level data alone does not show (rc1/moby.gd reads it). Each rule names the function it comes from. Offsets are byte offsets into the moby's pvars. "game_hidden": the game's run (moby_states.json) hides it, but not for the reason the editor shows; the text says why it is drawn anyway.
